bullets.text: The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of 20 houses in Thiruvallur after cancelling waterbody land pattas, and the district team should monitor the evictions.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay opened CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre, and the portfolio team should track related investments.

stories.title: நீர்நிலை நிலத்தின் பட்டா ரத்து: திருவள்ளூரில் 20 குடியிருப்புகளை இடிக்கவும் உச்ச நீதிமன்றம் உத்தரவு
takeaways: The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of twenty residential units on water body lands in Thiruvallur.
The district administration must enforce the court directive and provide alternative resettlement sites.

stories.title: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong, Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Open CapitaLand’s First Chennai Data Centre
takeaways: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong and CM C Joseph Vijay unveiled CapitaLand's first data centre in Chennai.
The high-profile inauguration strengthens bilateral economic ties and expands Tamil Nadu digital infrastructure.
